title: drift/v1
description: targets/<id>/drift/<timestamp>-<author>.yaml (F12-R11, R12; D-10 v3.12): what the watcher noticed about an inherited statement — `upstream-edit`, the path the target was imported from differs at upstream head from the pinned commit, with the diff attached; or `resolved-elsewhere`, the source lists the problem as no longer open, with the citation attached. A flagged `upstream-edit` freezes proving compute by deriving claimable: false for as long as the root's statement hash is the one recorded here; a D-8 revision changes the hash and lifts the flag, and a curator who judges the edit irrelevant appends a `cleared` record. The grade never moves on a drift record (D-9 downgrades on a confirmed defect, and a drift signal is not one). Append-only; every string here is untrusted upstream text, capped and escaped at render (F12 §7). Versioned, never edited (D-34).

state.description: `flagged` by the watcher; `cleared` by a curator, naming the flag it clears in `clears`.

statement_hash.description: The root's statement hash when the record was written; the flag applies while it is the current one.

upstream.description: For `upstream-edit`: where the statement came from, and the two commits compared.

citation.description: For `resolved-elsewhere`: the source's page, the status it shows and the line it shows it with.

diff.description: The unified diff between the pinned and the head version of the path, capped at 16 KiB; untrusted text.

clears.description: For a `cleared` record: the file name of the flag it clears.
